name: Sakura Drift
css:
/* Sakura Drift: a cherry branch over a misty lake and pagoda (original gouache-style illustration). Petals drift down past the window a few times on load and keep falling while the agent works; washi-paper cards and a blossom-pink composer whose stem fills as the context does. Light only. */
 :root{--t3-radius-composer: 20px;--t3-radius-bubble: 18px;--t3-radius-card: 12px;--t3-radius-control: 9px;--t3-composer-outline: rgb(214 120 150 / 0.4);--sd-pink: #e3829f;--sd-deep: #b84a6e;--sd-ink: height='320'%3E%3Cpath transform='translate(40 30) rotate(20) scale(1.4)' d='M0 -9c4 3 6 7 3 13-1 2-2 4-3 5-1-1-2-3-3-5C-6 -2-4 -6 0 -9z' fill='%23f4b6c8' fill-opacity='.9'/%3E%3Cpath transform='translate(230 120) rotate(-35) scale(1.0)' d='M0 -9c4 3 6 7 3 13-1 2-2 4-3 5-1-1-2-3-3-5C-6 -2-4 -6 0 -9z' fill='%23f4b6c8' fill-opacity='.9'/%3E%3Cpath transform='translate(120 230) rotate(60) scale(1.2)' d='M0 -9c4 3 6 7 3 13-1 2-2 4-3 5-1-1-2-3-3-5C-6 -2-4 -6 0 -9z' fill='%23f4b6c8' fill-opacity='.9'/%3E%3Cpath transform='translate(330 270) rotate(140) scale(0.9)' d='M0 -9c4 3 6 7 3 13-1 2-2 4-3 5-1-1-2-3-3-5C-6 -2-4 -6 0 -9z' fill='%23f4b6c8' fill-opacity='.9'/%3E%3Cpath transform='translate(300 60) rotate(-80) scale(1.1)' d='M0 -9c4 3 6 7 3 13-1 2-2 4-3 5-1-1-2-3-3-5C-6 -2-4 -6 0 -9z' fill='%23f4b6c8' fill-opacity='.9'/%3E%3Cpath transform='translate(180 300) rotate(10) scale(0.8)' d='M0 -9c4 3 6 7 3 13-1 2-2 4-3 5-1-1-2-3-3-5C-6 -2-4 -6 0 -9z' fill='%23f4b6c8' fill-opacity='.9'/%3E%3C/svg%3E")}[data-t3-part="app-shell"]{isolation: isolate;accent-color: var(--sd-pink);background: var(--t3-asset-art) right top / cover no-repeat,var(--sd-mist)}[data-t3-part="app-shell"]::after{content: "";position: fixed;z-index: -1;inset: -640px 0 0 0;background: var(--sd-petals) 0 0 / 400px 320px repeat;pointer-events: none;opacity: 0.85}[data-t3-part="main"]{--app-theme-canvas: transparent}[data-t3-part="sidebar"]{--app-theme-sidebar: transparent;background: linear-gradient(180deg,rgb(255 250 246 / 0.86),rgb(253 241 240 / 0.9));backdrop-filter: blur(14px);border-right: 1px solid rgb(227 130 159 / 0.25)}.sidebar-stage-backdrop{display: none}[data-t3-part="sidebar-header"] a>span{color: var(--sd-deep)}[data-t3-part="sidebar-header"] a>span>span{font: 600 19px/1 var(--sd-serif);color: var(--sd-ink);letter-spacing: 0.04em}[data-t3-part="sidebar-header"] a>span::after{content: "\2740";margin-left: 7px;color: var(--sd-pink);font-size: 14px}[data-t3-part="sidebar-search"]{background: #fffdfb;box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(227 130 159 / 0.3)}[data-t3-part="sidebar-toolbar"] button{color: var(--sd-deep)}[data-t3-part="thread-row"]{background: linear-gradient(90deg,var(--sd-pink) 0 3px,transparent 3px),#fffdfa;box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(200 150 150 / 0.22),0 4px 12px -8px rgb(120 60 70 / 0.45)}[data-t3-part="thread-row"]:hover{background: linear-gradient(90deg,var(--sd-pink) 0 3px,transparent 3px),#fff}[data-t3-part="thread-row"][data-t3-variant="card"] [data-t3-part="thread-body"]{height: auto;padding-block: 10px}[data-t3-part="thread-title"]{white-space: normal;overflow: visible;text-overflow: clip;font: 600 14.5px/1.35 var(--sd-serif);color: var(--sd-ink)}[data-t3-part="project-name"]{color: var(--sd-deep);letter-spacing: 0.05em}[data-t3-part="thread-status"],[data-t3-part="thread-meta"]{color: #9a7d82}[data-t3-part="thread-row"][aria-current="page"]{background: linear-gradient(90deg,var(--sd-deep) 0 3px,transparent 3px),linear-gradient(135deg,#fde7ee,#fbd5e1);box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(184 74 110 / 0.45),0 8px 18px -10px rgb(184 74 110 / 0.6)}[data-t3-part="thread-row"][data-t3-agent="working"]{box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--sd-pink),0 0 16px -2px rgb(227 130 159 / 0.8)}[data-t3-part="thread-row"][data-t3-agent="waiting"]{outline: 1.5px dashed var(--sd-deep);outline-offset: 2px}[data-t3-part="sidebar-section-header"]{color: var(--sd-deep);font-family: var(--sd-serif);letter-spacing: 0.12em}[data-t3-part="chat-header"]{background: linear-gradient(180deg,rgb(255 250 246 / 0.85),rgb(255 250 246 / 0.55));backdrop-filter: blur(10px);border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(227 130 159 / 0.2)}[data-t3-part="chat-header"] nav li:last-child h2 span{font: 600 17px/1.2 var(--sd-serif);color: var(--sd-ink);letter-spacing: 0.03em}[data-t3-part="user-message-bubble"]{background: linear-gradient(135deg,#f9cddb,#f2a9c0);color: #4a1f2e;border: 0;box-shadow: 0 8px 20px -10px rgb(184 74 110 / 0.6)}[data-t3-part="user-message-bubble"] *{color: inherit}[data-t3-part="assistant-message"]:has(.chat-markdown){background: rgb(255 252 249 / 0.9);border-radius: var(--t3-radius-card);padding: 18px 22px 10px;box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(200 150 150 / 0.25),0 16px 36px -18px rgb(120 60 70 / 0.45);color: var(--sd-ink);font-family: var(--sd-serif)}[data-t3-part="assistant-message"] :not(pre)>code{background: #fdeef2;border-color: #f2c4d2;color: #a3375c}[data-t3-part="code-block"]{box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #f0dcdc}[data-t3-part="composer-surface"]{position: relative;background: rgb(255 253 250 / 0.94);box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.4),0 16px 40px -16px rgb(120 60 70 / 0.5)}[data-t3-part="composer-surface"]::before{content: "";position: absolute;z-index: 21;left: 26px;right: 26px;top: 0;height: 2px;border-radius: 2px;background: linear-gradient(90deg,#6b4a3a,var(--sd-pink));transform-origin: left;transform: scaleX(var(--t3-context-used,0));pointer-events: none}[data-t3-part="composer-context"]{background: rgb(255 250 246 / 0.8)}[data-t3-part="composer-toolbar"] button[aria-label="Submit message"]{background: linear-gradient(135deg,var(--sd-pink),var(--sd-deep));color: #fff}[data-t3-part="chat"][data-t3-agent="working"] [data-t3-part="composer-surface"]{box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgb(227 130 159 / 0.25),0 0 30px -6px rgb(227 130 159 / 0.8)}[data-t3-part="sidebar-content"],[data-t3-part="transcript"]{scrollbar-color: #eab3c4 transparent}@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference){[data-t3-part="app-shell"]::after{animation: sd-fall 26s linear 2}[data-t3-part="app-shell"]:has([data-t3-part="chat"][data-t3-agent="working"])::after{animation: sd-fall 14s linear infinite}}@keyframes sd-fall{from{transform: translate3d(0,0,0)}to{transform: translate3d(-400px,640px,0)}}
